name: zmodel_matlbuffer_release_texture_surfaces
description: zModel_MatlBuffer::ReleaseTextureSurfaces walks active material slots and releases upload surfaces for texture-backed, unpinned materials, with the original 3DFX image-buffer release path preserved.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel material/source-cluster pass because this helper depends on material flag layout, renderer-path provider callbacks, and class/source-file context.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x480fd0 validates active-list traversal from g_zModel_MatlActiveHeadIndex using zModel_MaterialSlot.nextPoolIndex, material flag gating on 0x0100 set and 0x0200 clear, null texture-directory-entry and null texture checks, the renderer path 2 call to zVid_Image::ReleaseOwnedBuffers, and the indirect call through g_zVideo_pfnTextureRecordReleaseUploadSurfaceRef.

The native smoke verifies that only an unpinned active material with flag 0x0100, a texture-directory entry, and a non-null texture reaches the upload-surface release callback while pinned, missing-entry, and unflagged active slots are skipped.
